content: Samaria runacuna Jesusta chrasquicurcangan
Jinarcurmi fariseocunaga musyarärira Juanpita, mas achcata Jesús bautizayanganta, jinaman mas achca runa gatirarcayanganta.
Manam Jesusga bautizarachu, antis nogacuna discïpuluncunalam bautizapäcurä.
Nätan Jesús chayta musyarurga nogacunawanmi yargora chay Judeachru cayanganpita Galileaman cutinanpag.
Chay cutir, pasapäcunä cara Samaria marca ninganpam.
Chaura aywarcayangächrümi chrarärï Sicar ningan marcaman, churin Josëta Jacob gongan pampa tincugman.
Chaychrümi cara Jacobpa yacu pözun rurasha. Chaura Jesús ushacasha aywayarga, pözu manyanmanmi tayurun. Chayüra nämi nachrgayara chraupi junagman.
Chaura discïpuluncunaga aywapäcurä micuy rantig Samaria marcatam.
Chaycamam juc warmiga chrarunag yacu wishicug. Chaytam Jesusga “Yaculay mama” nisha.
Niptin chay Samaria warmiga “¿Imanirtag Israel casta cayar, gamga yacuta manacayämanqui noga Samaria warmita? Manatag Israel casta runawan Samaria runacunaga rimapanacunchichu”.
Niptin Jesusga nisha: “Dios cuyapälar goshunayta tantiarga, nätan yacuta pi manacuyäshungaytas musyarga, gam manacamaptiqui, noga gorugman cawachicug yacutam”.
Niptin warmiga ninag: “Tayta, manatag charanquichu imatas yacuta jorgamunaypag, nätan yacuga cayan ruyichrüragtag. Chauraga ¿maypitatag gamga gomanqui chay cawachicug yacutaga?
¿Gamga cayanqui awillücuna Jacobpita mas munayniyogchu imatag? Paymi gopäcamasha cay pözutaga, quiquinsi churincunas uywancunas upyacunanta”.
Niptin Jesusga cay ninag: “Cay yaculata upyagtaga pitas maytas yapaymi yacunanga.
Nätan noga gongä cawachicug yacu upyagtaga, manam imaysi yacunangachu. Antis cawachicug yacuta noga gongäga runachru canga, juc pucyupita chaynuyla yacu yargayämugnuymi imaycamas cawag cananpag”.
Niptin warmiga ninag: “Tayta, gomay chay yacuta mana imaysi yacunämänanpag, nätan yacu jorgog mana cay pözuman imaysi aywamunäpag”.
Niptin Jesusga “Ayway, gowayta gayamuy, jinarcur cutimuy”.
Niptin warmiga cay nisha: “Manam canchu gowä”. Chaura Jesusga ninag: “ ‘Manam gowä canchu’ nirga, alitam nirunqui.
Gampaga goway cara pichgam, nätan canan cayächingaysi manam gowaychu. Chaynuy nirga razoncagtam niramanqui”.
Niptin warmiga ninag: “Tayta, gamga cayanqui Diospa willacugninmi.
Awillücunaga Diosta alawapäcug cay gotuchrümi. Nätan gamcuna castaga ‘Jerusalenchrümi Diosta alawachwan’ nipäcunquitan”.
Niptin Jesusga cay ninag: “Mamala, razonchri nï cay rimayangäta: Nämi pasay ayparayämun mana cay gotumansi u Jerusalenmansi aywalar Tayta Diosta alawapäcunaypag.
Samariapitacagga mana reguepäcungaytam alawarcayanqui, nätan nogacunaga musyarcayämi pita alawarcayangätas. Jinamanga salvacugsi aywayämun Israel casta runapitatan.
Nämi chay junag chraramun. Nätan chay junagchrümi nä cayanqui Tayta Diosta razonpa alawagcuna, lapan shongonpa alawapäcunan junagchrümi. Nätan Taytanchisi munayanga chaynuy alawapäcunantam.
Diosga Espiritum, nätan payta alawagcunaga razonpa alawapäcunman lapan shongonpam”.
Niptin warmiga cay ninag: “Musyayämi ‘Salvacugtam cachramushag’ Dios ningan aywamunanpita. Chaypita nä chraramur lapalanta pay tantiachipäcamänanta”.
Niptin Jesusga nisha: “Paymi noga cayä, gamwan canan rimayag”.

Chay niyaptilanmi discïpuluncunaga chrarärimü micuy rantig aywapäcungäpita. Jinarcurmi mayacasha nirag ricacarärï Samaria warmiwan rimaptinga. Nätan manatan maygäsi “¿Imatatag tapurayqui? u ¿imanirtag rimaray chay warmiwan?” nipäcurachüga.
Chaura warmiga wacuyninta dëjarcurmi aywacun marcata. Jinarcurmi chaychrüga cay nimusha:
“Shapäcamuy. Ricapäcamuy, lapan rurangäta nimag runata. ¡Paypishchri cayan ‘Salvacugtam cachramushag’ Dios ninganga!”
Niruptin runacunaga aywaytam galacayärimun Jesuscagman.
Chaycama nogacunaga Jesustam nircayä: “Yachrachig, micucurcuynar”.
Nipäcuptïga “Nogapagga cayan jucmi micunä gamcuna mana musyapäcungaymi” nipäcaman.
Chauraga “¿Pilas aparapamura micuytachur?” nir tapunacurcayaptïmi.
Jesusga cay nipäcaman: “Cachramagnï munanganta rurayaymi, nätan nimangancunata rurayaymi cayan nogapagga juc micuynuy.

Gamcunaga tarpurcur ‘Chruscu quillataran chrämunga cosëcha wichan’ nircayanquim. Nätan noga nipäcug: Rircaripäcuy shumag, nä micuy pogoshanuymi cayan wac yurag jacusha aywayämugcuna Diospita mayacurcänanpag.
Pi maysi cosëchachru mincayga chrasquinmi pägunta, nätan palansi imaycamas cawag capäcunanpagmi, chay tarpucugsi cosechagwan cushisha cananpag.
Chauraga alitam rimapäcun cay nir: ‘Tarpugga jucmi, nätan cosechagga juctan’ nir.
Gamcunata noga cachrayä cosechag, mana uryapäcungaymanmi. Chauraga juc runacunam uryapäcura. Jinatam gamcunaga chay uryacurcanganta cananga cosecharcayanqui” nipäcaman.
Jinarcurmi manacagpag ricasha chay Samaria runacunaga Jesusman yupachicurcasha achca, chay warmi “Lapan rurangätam niraman” niruptilan.
Chaura Samaria runacuna nä Jesuscagman chrarärimurga “Quëdashunnar tayta” nipäcura yapay yapay. Nipäcuptin Jesusga quëdara ishcay junagmi chaychru.
Jinarcurmi quiquin Jesús rimagta mayarärir runacunaga mas achca chrasquicarärin.

Chauraga chay warmita cay nipäcuram: “Cananga payman yupachicurcayä manam willapacamangalaypachu, antis quiquïcuna nogacunas mayapäcusha carmi. Nätan musyarcayäsi shumagmi lapan runa salvacug pay canganta” nipäcura.
Soldäducuna mandag Roma runa Jesusta chrasquicungan
Chaypita nä ishcay junag Samariachru carcurga Jesusga yargora, nogacuna discïpuluncunawan Galileata aywapäcunäpagmi.
Jesusga quiquinmi runacunata cay nira: “Diospa willacugnincuna, manam maygansi alipa chrasquisha canchu quiquinpa marcanchrüga” nira.
Chay ningannuylam Galileaman chraräriptïga, Jesusta chrasquirärin alipa, Jerusalenchru Pascua fiestaman aywar ima rurangantas ricasha capäcur.
Jinarcurmi cutiyarärï chay Galileachru, Canä ningan marcaman, yacuta vïnuman muyuchinganman. Chaura Capernaumchrüga cara reycagchru soldäducuna mandagmi Roma runa. Paypa churinmi gueshyasha.

Jinarcurmi Judeapita Canä marcaman Jesús chrämusha canganta nä mayarurga aywaramunag paywan tincug. Chaypitam Jesustaga “Aywaläshunnar wayïta tayta, olgo churiläta cuticächinaypag. Nämar pasay wanunayan” nin.
Chaura Jesusga cay ninmi: “Ima-aygatas munaynïwan mana ruraptïga, gamcuna juc castacunas manam ‘Diospitachr payga aywarayämun’ nipäcunquichu”.
Niptin chay gueshyapacug runaga cay ninmi: “Tayta, aywaläshunnar pasay-pacha, manaragsi churilä wanungancama”.
Niptin Jesusga cay ninmi: “Cuticuy wayiquita. Churiquiga cawangam”. Niptin runaga Jesús ningalanman yupachicularmi, aywacun.
Nä Capernaum marcaman jegarpuyaptinshi, rantisha runancunaga yargarärimun taripacug: “Churiquiga nä alim cayan” nir.
Chauraga tapurunshi: “¿Ima üranuypitam galayurun cuticayta?” Niptinga “Ganyan chraupi junag pasaruptilanmi acachaynin amaynarun” nipäcunshi.
Chaura chay runaga tantiarun chayüranuy “Cawangam churiquiga” Jesús ningantash. Chaura runaga lapan aylluntin Jesusman yupachicuytam galayapäcusha.
Caywanga nä ishcay cutim Jesusga reguechicura pi cangantas Judeapita Galileata aywar.
